work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: TO THE HOPEFVLL YOVNG COVPLE, THE RIGHT WORSHIPFVLL Mr. ROBERT COOKE Esquire, and the vertuous Gentlewoman, Mistres DOROTHIE COOKE his wife; many comfortable daies in Gods •ea•e and •auour to their mutuall and eternall good.

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Love your wife as yourself, for she is your own flesh.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: He that loueth his wife, he loueth himselfe.

items.text: Cleave to your wife, leaving father and mother, and hold to her as one flesh.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: For this cause shall a man leaue father and mother too, and shall cleaue to his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

items.text: Love your wife with a love above all other love, because you two are one flesh.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: loue his wife with a loue aboue all other loue

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Submit to your husband as the church submits to Christ.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the wife is to be subiect to her husband, as the Church is to Christ

items.text: Acknowledge your husband as your head and superior, and do not usurp authority over him.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: acknowledge her husband, as God hath appointed him, to be her superiour

items.text: Reverence your husband with honor and godly fear.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: The first dutie is Reuerence; which comprehendeth two things, Honour, Feare.

items.text: Obey your husband as part of your submission.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: And these duties may bee referred, or reduced to three heads - Reuerence, - Obedience, - Assistance.

items.text: Assist your husband as a helper suited to him.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Shee was made to be as an helpe vnto him.

items.text: Rule your wife as the head rules the body, with care and governance.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the husband to rule the wife as the head or soule doth the body.

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Submit to your husband as is fitting in the Lord.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Wiues, submit your selues vnto your Husbands; as it is c•mely in the Lord.

items.text: Love your wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Husbands, loue your Wiues

items.text: Do not be bitter toward her.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: and bee not bitter to them

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Honor thy husband with reverent thought, speech, and behavior, avoiding contemptuous words or carriage.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: all women, high or low, doe giue honour to their husbands: and it consisteth in a reuerent and respectfull carriage towards them

items.text: Seek to please thy husband in all things lawful, and avoid whatever displeases him, out of reverent love.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: desire to doe euery thing so as may please their husband and giue him contentment, and a care to shun and auoid whatsoeuer may displease him

items.text: Receive his admonitions meekly and amend what he faults, even when he blames unjustly, bearing it patiently without retort.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: being content to be admonished of him, and taking his admonitions in good parts; and being willing to reforme and amend what he admonisheth her of as amisse

items.text: Take his advice and follow his guidance in personal, domestic, and household matters, as he is thy guide.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: suffering her selfe to be aduised of him; in taking aduice of him, and following aduice giuen by him

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Submit to him as to your head, in comely subjection.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the wiues maine dutie here is subiection

items.text: Be forward in your duty to him; do not strain courtesy or wait for him to first do his part.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: not to straine courtesie and stand vpon tearmes, as to say, Let him doe what he should doe, and then I will doe what is befitting me.

items.text: After any breach or offense, seek reconciliation with him first, and break off the intermission of duties.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the wife is in duty rather to seeke reconcilement

items.text: Love her as your principal duty.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the mans principally Loue

items.text: Do not omit your duty of love even if she is slack or faulty in her submission.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Not that it is lawfull for the superiour to omit his dutie, if the inferiour be slacke or faultie in the performance of hers

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Do not forsake your husband when trouble falls; share and endure adversity with him.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: leaue and forsake their husbands when they are fallen into troubles

items.text: Do not bring him into decay by wasteful spending, but help him bear his burdens.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: in stead of helping to beare his burden with him

items.text: Comfort and cheer your husband in his heaviness, as a physician in sickness.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: by being a cheerer and a comforter; a meanes of comfort and cheerefulnesse to him

items.text: Do your husband good and not evil all the days of your life.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Shee will doe her husband good, and not euill, all the daies of her life

items.text: Submit to your husband out of conscience toward God, not merely from fear or worldly advantage.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: performed not for worldly respects, or for feare of wrath, but for conscience sake

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Be a keeper at home, managing domestic affairs as his helper in labor and business.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: women be house-keepers, or keepers at home

items.text: Diligently and carefully educate the children God gives you.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: the diligent and carefull education of such children as it may please God to blesse them with all.

items.text: Oversee the entire household: instruct, admonish, assign work, and allot allowances.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: the vigilant and watchfull ouersight of the whole family instructing and admonishing them, as occasion requireth; assigning them their worke and allotting them their allowance.

items.text: Faithfully keep and preserve the provisions he brings in, allowing no waste or spoiling.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: the prouident and faithfull keeping and preseruing of prouisions made and brought in by the man, that they bee not imbecilled or made away, that no waste be made of them

items.text: Labor constantly to support, build up, and increase the household's estate.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: a constant and painefull endeauour of doing something... toward the supporting and vpholding, or the raising and aduancing of their estate

items.text: Train daughters before marriage to be able helpers in domestic affairs, not idle or unfit.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: bring them vp so in idlenes and dissolutenesse, that they are good for nothing when they are married

items.text: Bear part with him in troubles and crosses as a fellow-partner in afflictions.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: a yoke fellow to her husband, as in his trauels and labours, so in troubles and crosses

items.text: Comfort him in his troubles and crosses.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: by being a comfort vnto him

items.text: Dwell with your wife; do not live apart from her.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: husbands dwell with their wines

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Submit to your husband as to the Lord, even if he is undeserving or failing in his duty, because God commands it of you.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: submit themselues to their husbands bee they good or badde, deserue they well or euill of them, as for God

items.text: Do not submit to your husband in anything that is against God; obey God rather than man when their commands clash.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: God is rather to be obeyed then man

items.text: Do not advise, persuade, induce, or urge your wife to anything against God and good conscience, lest you abuse your authority.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: take heede how they take vpon them to aduise, perswade, induce or vrge their wiues to ought against God and godlinesse or good conscience

items.text: Love your wife; this is the chief duty required of the husband.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Husbands loue your wiues

items.text: Do not be bitter toward your wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: be not bitter vnto them

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Admonish him seasonably and with respect to his person and place.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: That admonition be giuen seasonably... with due respect and regard of the husbands person and place.

items.text: Submit your advice and opinion to his judgment and discretion.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: submit her adu•ce and op•nion to his iudgement and discr•tion

items.text: Be willing to obey him if he decides otherwise.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: Shew her selfe willing to obey, if he shall thinke good otherwise.

items.text: Use all your gifts and graces for his honor, not to seem wiser than he.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: shee should vse all the gifts and graces of God bestowed on her for the honour of him

items.text: Do not act on your own judgment; ask and follow your husband's advice.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: that will do all of their owne head... refuse and thinke scorne either to aske of their husbands aduice

items.text: If he insists on something not evil, obey meekly to keep peace with God and man.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: if the husband shall persist... she ought... to buy her owne peace... by meeke and quiet obseruance

items.text: Govern your wife, admonish her, and give her counsel and advice.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: then is he to gouerne and admonish, to giue counsell and aduice.

items.text: Labor for holy wisdom and spiritual discretion to guide your wife well.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: he must labour for holy wisedome and spirituall discretion, that hee may be fit and able to guide and gouerne

items.text: Make known your mind to your wife about how family matters should be ordered.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: without informing or acquainting them with their minde, in what manner they wish or thinke fit to haue things ordered in the family

items.text: Rejoice when your wife seeks your mind; do not rage or mock her.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: a wise and discreete husband should rather reioyce that his wife is so carefull to know his minde... then contemne her or miscall her

items.text: Do not be overhasty to marry your children before they are settled; help them toward that.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: parents... must not be ouerhasty to ioyne their children in that estate... So they must be carefull... to further them with all conuenient helps

items.text: Assist your husband, being a helper to him in his labors and troubles.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: She was made to be an Helper or an assistant to her husband: and that especially in two kinds, in his Trauels, and in his Troubles.

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Cover and conceal your wife's infirmities; do not broadcast them to others.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: couering & concealing the infirmities of their wiues

items.text: Be tender over your wife's natural defects; do not let them diminish your love for her.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: if morall defaults must not diminish loue, much lesse naturall defects

items.text: Do not cast off your wife when she ages or becomes diseased; maintain your love for her throughout her life.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: cast of the wife of their youth, when she growes aged or diseased

items.text: Seek mutual concord with your wife; condescend to her in things equal and fit, and regard her pleasure and contentment, not just your own will.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: mutuall Concord and agreement, and to this purpose a condescending to the wife in things equall and fit

items.text: Banish all bitterness toward your wife; admonish, advise, and reprove her in love and a loving manner, without harshness.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: the banishing of all Bitternes

items.text: Rejoice and delight in your wife; take joy in her love and companionship.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Ioy & delight in her

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Have but one wife, and do not embrace the bosom of a stranger or give way to ranging affections, for as Christ has but one Church, so must you have but one wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Christ hath but one Church: and hee must haue but one wife.

items.text: Love her with an inward and entire affection; do not let your first love abate or grow lukewarm, but let it increase rather than decrease.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: take heede not onely of ceasing simply to loue, but of leauing their first loue: of suffring their Loue to grow luke-warme

items.text: Dwell together peaceably and quietly; do not separate over light jarrs or take occasions for unnecessary absence, for the man is head and the woman body, and it is death to be sundered.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Take heede, Oh man, how thou leauest the wife of thy youth... take heede, O woman, how thou forsakest the guide of thy youth.

items.text: Bear patiently with her infirmities; conceal and cover them, remembering that love is long-suffering and covers a multitude of offences.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Loue couereth, much more feruent loue, a multitude of offences.

items.text: Do not match your son young and then send him traveling, lest affections be not fastened and either party be estranged.
items.citation: Marriage Duties, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: parents, who match their sonnes young to wiues, and then send them a trauailing

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Love your wife with a singular, peculiar, entire affection, drawing your heart from all other women to her alone.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: he must draw home his affections from louing any other in that sort... such loue as this is, is or ought to be peculiar and proper to one

items.text: Love your husband and requite his love; do not fail in love even if he is angry or fails, and do not return anger for anger or control for control.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: if the husband be angry with the wife, shee is not by and by to be hastie and angry againe with him... but he is to loue her, and shee is likewise to loue him: yea though he should hate her, yet ought she to loue him

items.text: Have only your own wife; let every man have his own peculiar wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: Let euery man haue his owne peculiar wife

items.text: Have only your own husband; let each woman have her own husband.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: each woman e her husband

items.text: If you married without full affection, strive now to bring your heart to love your spouse, asking God for grace.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: those that haue already ouershot themselues in this kind, they must now striue euen to enforce their affections; and craue grace at Gods hand

items.text: Love your children, as nature and Scripture require; do not be lacking in natural affection.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19, MARRIAGE DVTIES.
items.quote: as the loue of parents to their children, a thing grounded in nature

work: Marriage Duties Briefely Couched Togither out of Colossians 3. 18, 19
heading: MARRIAGE DVTIES.

items.text: Be content with her as the wife God has given you, and delight in her above all others, not because she is the best, but because she is your wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: she is the fittest wife for him, that God hath allotted him, and therefore rest himself contented in her

items.text: Do not prefer the company of others over your wife, nor find her company unsavory; delight in her as your wife.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: delight rather in the company of others then of their owne wiues

items.text: Provide for her all necessary maintenance that your estate can afford, upholding her as the elm upholds the vine.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: the allowance of all necessaries that her neede shall require & their estate may afford

items.text: Do not live idly on her labor or waste her portion, leaving her destitute; support her as you ought.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: liue, like drones, on their wiues labours, wasting all that is gathered togither by their industrie

items.text: Diligently endeavor her spiritual good, teaching and instructing her, seeking to bring her to God and help her forward in godliness.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: to bring her on vnto God, or to help her on in the good waies of God

items.text: Live together as fellow heirs of salvation, furthering one another in the grace of God, and refer your married life to God's glory.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: liue togither... as fellow-heires of saluation... fellow-furtherers either of other

items.text: Live together in mutual love and concord, not in bitterness, discord, or discontent, as becomes Christians.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: liue togither vntowardly, discontentedly, impatiently, in gal & bitternes, in dissentiō & discord

items.text: Do not waste the estate that should maintain your children; provide for them as you do for yourself.
items.citation: Marriage Duties Briefly Couched Together, MARRIAGE DVTIES
items.quote: they robbe wife and children and themselues of what they wast
